title: Dharma
desc: Intolerant of injustice, Dharma is arrested for killing a man for molesting his sister. Upon his release, he becomes a powerful gangster to fight off evil in society.

title: Varuvan Manikandan
desc: An ardent devotee of Lord Ayyappan narrates tales of various miracles performed by the Hindu deity where the Almighty tests the devotion of his followers.

title: Sirithu Vazha Vendum
desc: A young boy is the only survivor after his family faces a brutal attack. However, as he grows, the unfortunate night continues to haunt him, so he decides to look for his parents' killer.

title: Kadhal Oviyam
desc: A village girl falls in love with an orphan with visual impairment. However, when her mother wishes her to marry a well-settled, she elopes with him.

title: Mudhal Mariyadhai
desc: A middle-aged upper-caste man, Malaichami, leads an unhappy married life but seeks comfort in a new friendship with a low-caste woman. However, their friendship leads to many rumours in their village.
